pool.text: Port Said was established during the building of the Suez Canal.
The permanent population of Port Said had reached 10,000.
The British entered Port Said and started their occupation of Egypt.
Egyptian cotton from Mataria started to be exported via Port Said.
A standard gauge railway opened to Cairo from Port Said.
The quickly growing city of Port Said had about 50,000 inhabitants.
The new city of Port Said was founded in December.
A treaty was signed between the United Kingdom and Egypt.
Skirmishes occurred with British troops guarding the Suez Canal.
British troops violently landed in Port Said while firing.
The withdrawal of the last foreign troops happened in Port Said.
Port Said Military Museum was inaugurated to narrate Egyptian resistance.
Port Said was declared a duty-free port attracting people.
The Misr Public Library in Port Said was founded.
The port of Port Said transported millions of TEU containers.
The airport in Port Said was reopened after being modernised.
The city witnessed the construction of the New Suez Canal.
Museum of the Authority of the Suez Canal was inaugurated.
Port Said Opera House was inaugurated for performances.
East Port Said National University and Al Salam Technological University established.
